verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Shelter me, O God
Hide me in the shadow of Your wings
You alone are my hope

verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
When my foes around me
Set me high above their reach
Hear me when I call Your name

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
As a mother gathers her young
Beneath her care
Gather me into Your arms

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Though I walk in darkness
Through the needles eye of death
You will never leave my sight
